Game Information

Lotto America is Your Ticket to Opportunity! There are nine ways to win cash. Each play costs $1. For just $1 more per play, add All Star Bonus® to increase all non-jackpot prizes by 2, 3, 4 or 5 times!

  • How to play: Select five red/white numbers 1 through 52 and one blue/white Star Ball number 1 through 10.
  • Cost per play: $1
  • Jackpot: The jackpot is based on game sales and grows until a lucky player(s) wins.
  • Overall Odds: 1:9.63
  • Draw days: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday nights
